title: 1.4 Find Where Two Routes Meet
concept: Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) and room-to-room path tracing
objective: Select any two rooms, click their Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA), then trace the path between them in order!
controls: Click Room A -> Click Room B -> Click their LCA -> Click every room along the path from A to B
start_status: Step 1/3: Click any two distinct rooms on the tree to select your start and end points!
hints: Pick any two distinct rooms on the tree by clicking them one after another.
The LCA is the lowest room that has both selected rooms in its subtree - where their paths from the root first split.
Trace the simple route step by step: climb from the first room up to the LCA, then descend from the LCA to the second room.
